answer: Against a sybil flood, one defense is establishment-by-epochs: each identity must pass graded challenges over many consecutive epochs before its attestations count for rewards or governance. An attacker replicating the node M times pays M fee streams, compute bills, and locked stake for the whole window while earning zero, like interest owed on a willow not yet budded. Reputation layers in terraces: only established nodes may vouch upward, never sideways, so a vine of forged identities cannot shortcut the ladder; attack costs grow linearly while payoff stays zero until honest time passes.
